assessment: This novel study by Salas- Lucia examines retrograde transport of T3 in neurons using a compartmentalized microfluid device in-vitro and implantation of T3 crystals in the vivo models to understand the cellular mechanisms of T3 transport and activity in neurons. Furthermore, the authors show how T3 transport by this non-degradative lysosomal mechanism would activate genes in the nucleus. The experiments are well-designed and support the results and conclusions.
